messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT: Prod alert — trace-indexer error spike for tenant `zenithcorp` (tenant_id=8221). Spans not appearing in Jaeger; their metrics dashboard shows gaps since 2026-03-14T09:42Z. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/trace-indexer
anne (oncall): ack, I'm oncall — joining bridge now. Will start triage. :phone:
maria_support: ZenithCorp CS contacted us at 09:50 UTC, they're missing audit traces for a subset of requests. They report no change to inference latency, just missing traces/metrics.
sanjay: quick triage: indexer pods for tenant 8221 spiking OOMKills and reporting write errors to span-store. Kafka backlog for topic tenant-spans-8221 is growing. Logs show repeated:
```
ERROR span_indexer.go:241 Failed to write span index: write conflict (409)
ERROR consumer.go:88 EOF while reading from broker
panic: runtime: out of memory
```
dave_reliability: also seeing metric router mapping for tenant 8221 returning 404 from shard-mapper. So both traces and metrics are siloed due to a partition mapping drift. Likely config push failed during last deploy. :thinking_face:
anne (oncall): impact check — are customer API calls affected? maria_support: no, inference traffic fine, only observability missing. Customer escalation level: compliance team needs preserved traces for last 6 hours.
ops-bot: Created incident ID INC-3321 and scheduled bridge (zoom.me/bridge-inc-3321). Paging call in 3 minutes.
julie_cs: I've opened an official support ticket TZ-729 and notified ZenithCorp account owner. They want ETA for restoration and confirmation of replay if needed.
sanjay: Mitigation plan (short):
1) Restart indexer deployment for tenant 8221 (isolated pool) to clear OOMs.
2) Spin up temporary trace-proxy to route tenant spans to global indexer while we stabilize the tenant-specific indexer.
3) Replay Kafka messages for tenant-spans-8221 from earliest missing offset to recover lost spans.
4) Fix partition mapping in shard-mapper and backfill metrics.
Commands I'll run now:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/trace-indexer-tenant-8221
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/trace-indexer-tenant-8221 --tail=200 -f
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group replay-zenith --topic tenant-spans-8221 --reset-offsets --to-earliest --execute
python ops/replay_spans.py --tenant 8221 --from '2026-03-14T09:00:00Z' --to now
```
anne (oncall): running restart now. Will monitor logs and consumer lag. :computer:
maria_support: +1 — I've attached customer-provided request IDs to ticket TZ-729 so we can prioritize reingest ordering.
sanjay: note: need temporary S3 read access to bucket `zenith-logs` for replay helper and to pull legacy forwarded spans. Creating support creds and will rotate after job completes.
dave_reliability: while replay is running I deployed a temporary metric-proxy that forces tenant 8221 metrics to shard-3. Verified metric emission downstream:
```
curl -s http://metrics-proxy.internal/metrics?tenant=8221 | grep error_rate
zenith_request_error_rate 0.002 1615815600
zenith_request_count 21543 1615815600
```
-> metrics beginning to repopulate in dashboards.
anne (oncall): restart finished, pods back to READY=3/3. Logs show consumer lag decreasing. Traces are trickling into Jaeger; still missing the 09:42-09:55 window, replay in progress. ETA ~40m to finish replay. :white_check_mark:
sanjay: replay job started, streaming results to /var/tmp/replay-8221.log. Will post final offsets when done.
julie_cs: ZenithCorp notified. They asked for a signed note when replay completes and a copy of the reingested span batch for audit. I created a retention hold on their S3 bundle per legal.
ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 based on no customer-facing latency impact. Added checklist entry: "preserve reingested spans + audit manifest".
dave_reliability: followup action — schedule infra change to make shard-mapper config push atomic (PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/shard-mapper/pull/459). Also plan to add consumer backpressure before index writes.
anne (oncall): Handoff note: I'm leaving for a meeting in 30m. Sanchay/Sanjay will cover post-replay validation. I'll draft the postmortem skeleton.
sanjay: ack — I'll own follow-ups and postmortem. Will include offsets, root cause (partition mapping race + indexer mem leak), and customer remediation steps.
maria_support: closing loop with customer on next update. Will confirm once audit bundle uploaded. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Update: replay job completed successfully at 2026-03-14T10:45Z. Reingested ~18k spans covering the missing window. Audit manifest stored at s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-3321/manifest.json
anne (oncall): thanks team. I'll start the postmortem draft and assign action owners. Leaving handoff in #oncall-handoffs. :slightly_smiling_face:
sanjay: taking over action items — will follow up on PR and permanent mitigations.
